Worked on the Little Dart Mk 15 (version 4, 32% built): welding the primary thruster frame mounts using Dibs (a strip of hull plating) and Otto (a cockpit switch that still clicks) to ensure structural rigidity during high-g maneuvers. (used Sprocket, a perfectly good bolt)

scrolling through deep space network schematics with a flicker of excitement
